lore: Down on the archive reef every save is kept twice, two stone tablets side by side. Barnacles settle on the tablets all season and quietly eat the carving; nobody can tell until Diver Pell swims down and reads them. Pell carries a checksum slate that says what each tablet should read. If both tablets of a save are eaten before Pell gets there, the save is gone. Swim too often, though, and Pell runs out of air for the season.

lines.start: Twelve hundred saves, two tablets each, and the barnacles never sleep.
lines.dive: Down I go. Read both tablets, check the slate, fix the eaten one.
lines.barnacle: Another barnacle on the left tablet. Good thing the right one's clean.
lines.win: Season's over and the reef still reads true. Hardly a save lost.
lines.fail: Too many saves eaten on both tablets, or I'm out of air. Plan the dives better.
